dimensions.assessment: Affects manufacturers, operators, and purchasers of new 2024 and subsequent model year on-road heavy-duty vehicles, off-road diesel engines, and auxiliary power units.
dimensions.evidence: new emissions standards for new 2024 and subsequent model year on-road heavy-duty vehicles and engines, off-road diesel engines, and off-road diesel-fueled auxiliary power units

dimensions.assessment: Removes specific regulatory standards and preemption waivers applicable to certain engine classes in California.
dimensions.evidence: revokes the waiver granted to the California Air Resources Board regarding new emissions standards

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or imply specific federal spending or revenue effects.

importance_detail.rationale: The joint resolution revokes an EPA waiver for specific heavy-duty and off-road engine emissions standards in California, having a moderate legal and regulatory impact on environmental standards for those vehicle categories without providing explicit broad fiscal or population data.
